new_page.description: Commercial and industrial land for sale in Cloverdale on the MLS®, with recent land sales and the smallest new lot in each zone.

faq_heading: Cloverdale Commercial Land for Sale: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. For sale listings only.

Commercial and industrial land for sale in Cloverdale: lots and development sites listed on the MLS® as commercial land. For sale only; space for lease is not included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.

items.t: Cloverdale’s 700 acres of industrial land are counted within Surrey’s 2,713 hectares in the regional inventory (July 1, 2025). ([City of Surrey, Cloverdale Industrial Area](https://www.surrey.ca/sites/default/files/media/documents/CloverdaleIndustrialArea.pdf), read November 20, 2026)

blocks.text: What sold: commercial land in Surrey

In the second quarter of 2026, 15 of the 53 commercial sales in the City of Surrey were land properties, against 56 across the Lower Mainland. Commercial Edge reports Surrey as one city, so the figure covers all of Surrey, not only Cloverdale.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).

Cloverdale uses the City of Surrey zoning bylaw. The smallest new lot in each Surrey commercial and industrial zone is listed on the [South Surrey commercial land page](/south-surrey-commercial-land-for-sale.html), and every zone is on the [zoning guide](/zonings.html).

faq.q: How many commercial land properties sold in Surrey recently?
faq.a: 15 in the second quarter of 2026, out of 53 commercial sales in the City of Surrey (GVR Commercial Edge).
